biggest_catch: Rewards formally 'have no cash value' per the official terms, balances can expire after 90 days without a valid paper receipt (with a 7-day warning), and fees can change on notice — but the official support center and terms publish an exact coin-to-reward ladder with a $3 entry point, so the mechanism is fully verifiable.
catches: Official terms: rewards 'have no cash value' — payouts are gift cards, Venmo, or PayPal transfers, not a cash balance; PayPal only unlocks at Diamond level ($25+).
Balances may expire after 90 days without a valid paper receipt; CoinOut gives a 7-day warning before expiry (official terms).

Earning is tiered and capped: 10-50 coins per receipt by level (Bronze 10 / Silver 20 / Gold 30 / Platinum 40 / Diamond 50) for the first 25 valid receipts/week (125/month); beyond that, Silver+ earn only 10 coins per additional receipt.
Fees may change with notice per the official terms.
Level status updates on the 1st of each month based on the prior month's activity — your earning rate can drop.
At ~20 coins per receipt (Silver), the first $3 reward (3,000 coins) takes ~150 receipts — a real grind, disclosed honestly.

steps: Download the free CoinOut app from Google Play or the App Store.

Earn coins: submit photos of paper receipts (10-50 coins each by level, first 25/week and 125/month at full rate), connect email/retailer accounts, do surveys, daily check-ins (Gold+), CoinPlay, CoinView videos, badges, referrals, barcode missions.
Reach at least Silver level and 3,000 coins — the first reward is a $3 Your Choice gift card.
Tap My Coins > See Rewards and redeem: $3/$5/$10/$25/$50 per the official ladder (Venmo from Gold, PayPal at Diamond $25+).
Rewards are processed within seven business days (most approved within minutes).
Keep submitting valid paper receipts — balances can expire after 90 days without one (7-day warning given).
